title: Sequence-cohort SLI instrumentation and multi-region failover visualizer
creator: Asha Rangan
description:
Goal: Implement sequence-cohort aware SLI instrumentation and a linked visualizer that shows token-level latency SLIs, per-cohort thresholds, circuit-breaker state, and multi-region failover impact. Scope includes: 1) New SLI definitions that account for initial sequence prefix and tokenized tail behavior; 2) Lightweight sampling + full capture rules for cohorts; 3) Runtime instrumentation hooks (eBPF and runtime emitter) to produce token-level histograms and admit/evict events; 4) A dashboard combining golden signals (latency, error rate, saturation) with a heatmap of cohort drift and circuit breaker state transitions; 5) A synthetic failover runner that replays sampled traces under simulated region outage and admission-control policies.

Acceptance criteria:
- Per-tenant/per-route SLIs computed for p50/p95/p99 token-latency with cohorting by prefix-length bucket and tenant-priority band.
- Sampling strategy implemented: 1% uniform sample for long tails with full capture on requests that hit pre-defined danger signals (KV-miss + decode spikes).
- Dashboards: (a) Cohort heatmap showing p99 delta over baseline, (b) Circuit state timeline per-region, (c) Failover cascade visualizer that plays synthetic-run outputs.
- Alerts wired: p99 increase > 40ms sustained 5m for high-priority tenants, and a new failover alert when circuit opens in more than one AZ in a region.
- Runbook updated with steps to silence noisy alerts and to rollback admissions changes.

Instrumentation details:
- Histograms: dynamic bucketization per-cohort around observed median with fixed tail buckets [1ms,5ms,10ms,25ms,50ms,100ms,200ms,500ms,1s,2s].
- Sampling: deterministic 1% keyed by tenant-id + sequence-hash; full capture when token-decode-time > 120ms or kv-cache-miss > 0.05.
- Emit payload: token_index, token_latency_ms, decode_ms, kv_hit_boolean, route, tenant_id, region, shard_id, admit_score, circuit_state. Emitted via the runtime telemetry channel to the metrics pipeline with a new topic 'sli-token-v2'.
- Retention: raw sampled traces kept 7 days, aggregated histograms kept 90 days.

Trade-offs and rationale:
- We accept additional storage for sampled raw traces (7d) to enable root-cause replay; this increases cost but is bounded by sampling policy.
- Per-cohort buckets need periodic rebalance to avoid bucket fragmentation; initial implementation uses an offline job to recompute bucket anchors weekly (future: online adaptation).
- eBPF-based timing reduces overhead vs host-level timers but requires coordination with infra for kernel module rollout (see dependencies).
comments: 2025-01-12 - Kickoff: Reviewed design doc (confluence: /r/regional-resilience/sequence-cohort-sli) with PM and Observability. Decided on cohorting dimensions: prefix-length (0-16,17-64,65+), tenant-priority (S0,S1,S2), request-type (chat,completion,embed).

2025-01-18 - Prototype: Runtime hook implemented in the inference agent to emit minimal token metrics; measured <0.6% p99 noise on local canary under 50qps. PR: github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4281 (owner: @mliu).

2025-01-22 - Review: Observability SIG requested dynamic bucket plan and clarified retention. Agreed to store 7d raw samples; updated architecture diagram. Action: Marcus to provide cost estimate for storage. (see doc link).

2025-01-28 - Simulation: Run synthetic failover with current admission policy. Results: region-B outage produced KV miss spike from 2%->12% and p99 increased by ~85ms for the 65+ token cohort; regional circuit opened after threshold breach at 3m. Captured replay traces for analysis. Stored artifacts: s3://redwood-test/failover-runs/run-2025-01-28.tar.gz

2025-02-04 - Security/Infra: Kernel module rollout plan requested by infra team. Decided on two-phase rollout: canary kernel on dedicated infra pool, monitor for perf regressions for 72h before broader rollout. Assigned infra owner: Priya Das.

2025-02-08 - Dashboard: Initial Grafana canvas implemented (jira: DASH-908) with cohort heatmap and circuit timeline. UX feedback from Design: add colorblind-safe palette and add tenant filter. Marcus to iterate. PR: github.com/redwood/observability/pull/1392

2025-02-12 - Next steps: Wire alerts into PagerDuty for P1 tenants, add canary rollout to 3 high-traffic tenants for 2 weeks, run the failover simulator with admission-policy variations (aggressive shed vs conservative), and finalize runbook edits.
